name: Capability index definitions and centered-process reject rates (NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook 6.1.6)

source.primary: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods, Section 6.1.6 'What is Process Capability?': https://itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/pmc/section1/pmc16.htm
notes: Worked example: USL = 20, LSL = 8, mean = 16, s = 2.
Reject table for a process centered between the limits: Cp 1.00 -> 0.27%, 1.33 -> 64 ppm, 1.66 -> 0.6 ppm, 2.00 -> 2 ppb (as printed).
The reject table is defined by spec width in sigmas (6, 8, 10, 12); its Cp column is that width divided by 6, printed to 2 decimals (1.33 means 8/6).
